text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nya Ah!
?
He's going to fight!
This is not the place to open!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃあぁ～っ！？　
あいつ、
戦うつもりにゃ！
これじゃ開店準備どころじゃないにゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
It's bad.
If you leave it as it is, it will be inconvenienced in your neighborhood .... I have to bring a confectionery fold later and apologize ... I want to minimize the damage anyway!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずいな。
このままでは
ご近所にも迷惑がかかってしまう……
後ほど
菓子折りを持参して
お詫びをしなくては……
ともあれ
被害は最小限に抑えたいところだ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
The story of the manager's perspective is now aside!
First of all, it is to win that guy and calm down!
With the territory struggle!
text_block_list.orig_text:
経営者目線の話は今はいったん置いとくにゃ！
まずはあいつに勝って、
落ち着かせることが第一にゃ！
縄張り争いと一緒にゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
That's right ... yeah?
Is this a territory battle?
It seems that the scale of the story suddenly became smaller ...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうだな……
うん？　
これ、
縄張り争いなのか？
急に話のスケールが
小さくなったような……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about!
For cats, territorial dispute is important!
Employee training is one of the shops!
I have to protect it because I was targeted!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにを言ってるのにゃ！　
猫にとって縄張り争いは一大事！
従業員研修はお店の一大事！
狙われたからには
守らなくちゃいけないのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Um, it's true.
I can't afford to leave this situation.
Let's fight together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ、
確かにそうだな。
この状況を放置するわけにもいくまい。
力を合わせて戦うとしよう！
